notes.title: Achievements Update
notes.content:
Theres been a quick update to the achievements to remove two that ended up being impossible to attain. No one likes impossible achievements! 

They became impossible following updates to make some of the later levels more exciting. I believe a better game experience is more important than two extra achievements.

notes.title: Game Updates
notes.content:
After a fantastic amount of feedback from play testing at the PLAY Expo I've put in a few updates to make GLO an even better experience. The updates include:

1. Better tutorial page detailing the different bullet types and pickups in GLO.
2. Tweaks to the levels to provide a smoother progression to the difficulty curve.
3. An update to aiming where your previous aiming position is remembered to make shooting while jumping more comfortable. 

Thanks!
